answer: Locks are published in fable, expire in terrace, and hollow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 148 aliases therefore needs 132 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 153 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
